<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Registrant&#146;s registration statement on Form 10/A, as filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on
August&nbsp;8, 2000, and as amended on October&nbsp;12, 2000, and November&nbsp;9, 2000, is hereby amended to reflect the following changes: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman"
SIZE="2"><B>Item&nbsp;11. Description of Registrant&#146;s Securities to be Registered </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">On April&nbsp;12, 2006, Sybron Dental Specialties, Inc., a
Delaware corporation (the &#147;Company&#148;), entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the &#147;Merger Agreement&#148;), by and among the Company, Danaher Corporation, a Delaware corporation (&#147;Parent&#148;), and Smile Acquisition Corp.,
a Delaware corporation and an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Parent (the &#147;Purchaser&#148;), pursuant to which Parent has agreed to cause the Purchaser to commence a tender offer (the &#147;Offer&#148;) to purchase all of the Company&#146;s
common stock, par value $0.01 per share (the &#147;Common Stock&#148;), including the associated preferred stock purchase rights issued pursuant to the Rights Agreement dated as of December&nbsp;8, 2000 (the &#147;Rights Agreement&#148;), between
the Company and Computershare Trust Company, N.A. (formerly known as EquiServe Trust Company, N.A.), a national banking association, as Rights Agent. The Merger Agreement provides, among other things, for the making of the Offer by the Purchaser,
and further provides that, following the completion of the Offer, upon the terms and subject to the conditions of the Merger Agreement, and in accordance with the Delaware General Corporation Law, Purchaser will be merged with and into the Company
with the Company continuing as the surviving corporation and a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent (the &#147;Merger&#148;). </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">In connection with the Offer,
the Merger Agreement and the transactions contemplated thereby, the Board of Directors of the Company authorized the amendment of the Rights Agreement. On April&nbsp;12, 2006, the Company and the Rights Agent executed an amendment (the
&#147;Amendment&#148;) to the Rights Agreement. The Amendment provides, among other matters, that (i)&nbsp;none of Parent, the Purchaser, or any Affiliate or Associate of either shall be deemed to be an Acquiring Person or a Beneficial Owner of
Common Stock, either individually or collectively, solely as a result of the approval, execution, delivery, announcement or performance of the Merger Agreement, the commencement or consummation of the Offer, or the consummation of the Merger or any
of the other transactions contemplated in the Merger Agreement; and (ii)&nbsp;no Stock Acquisition Date, no Triggering Event, no Distribution Date, no Section&nbsp;11(a)(ii) Event and no Section&nbsp;13 Event shall be deemed to have occurred solely
as a result of the approval, execution, delivery, announcement or performance of the Merger Agreement, the commencement or consummation of the Offer, or the consummation of the Merger or any of the other transactions contemplated in the Merger
Agreement. The Amendment also provides that the Rights Agreement and the Rights established thereby will terminate in all respects immediately prior to the Effective Time (as defined in the Merger Agreement). </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Capitalized terms used and not otherwise defined herein have the meanings ascribed to them in the Rights Agreement and the Amendment. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The foregoing summary of the principal terms of the Amendment is a general description only and is subject to the detailed terms and conditions of the Amendment, a copy
of which is attached as Exhibit&nbsp;4.1(a) to this Amendment No.&nbsp;3 to Form&nbsp;10/A and incorporated herein by reference. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Item&nbsp;15.
Financial Statements and Exhibits </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
